summary:
Iteration 13: validated the 'Templates = Plain Text only' simplification. Backend: new /app/backend/tests/test_iter13.py (22 cases) — html_has_visible_content unit (empty editor markup
/


/  now correctly = not visible), send_email MIME unit (empty html_body => a SINGLE text/plain part, no text/html and no HTML markup in the raw message), /api/templates/preview (email_html == '', {first_name}/{company}/{saudacao} substituted in subject+body, both {var} and {{var}} syntaxes, signature appended as text), template persistence (create => content_html '', update of a legacy HTML template clears content_html, delete removes), campaign start with a plain-text template (recipients=1, status 'sending'), worker branching source guard. ALL 22 PASS. Full regression suite (-n 0): 186 passed / 1 skipped. Frontend (Playwright, logged in as carlos.miguel@smartize.pt): Templates modal now contains ONLY name, subject + Variável dropdown, plain Textarea + 'Inserir variável', and footer Preview/Cancelar/Guardar — no contenteditable/rich text, no iframe, no HTML tab, 0 formatting buttons. Variable insertion at cursor works for subject ({{first_name}}) and body ({{saudacao}}{{first_name}}). Preview shows plain 
 text with variables replaced ('Caro Caro João,', 'Smartize'), subject 'Ola João', text/plain note, no grey HTML card/iframe. Save persisted (verified via GET /api/templates: content_html == ''), delete works. Modal footer buttons remain reachable at 768x620. All other pages (/contactos /grupos /campanhas /negocios /estatisticas /configuracoes) load with zero console errors.

minor.issue: When the template is plain text (full_html == ''), no open pixel and no click-tracking rewrite is injected (text_body is sent as-is). Consequence: opens/clicks will always be 0 for every plain-text campaign, so Estatísticas/CampaignDetail rates become permanently 0%. Expected trade-off of text/plain, but the UI should state it (or at least rewrite links in the text body for click tracking).

The default account signature is image-only HTML (). html_to_text() of it returns '', so plain-text emails and the preview end up with NO signature at all, while the UI footnote says 'inclui a assinatura da conta predefinida no fim'. Recommend a plain-text signature field per SMTP account (or an alt/text fallback).

ui_bugs.issue:
DATA LOSS on legacy templates: openEdit sets content_text: t.content_text and drops content_html entirely. For a legacy template ('QA Template 1', content_html '

Ola {first_name} 1

', content_text 'Ola') the editor loads only 'Ola'; pressing Guardar permanently deletes the HTML body. Fallback should be content_text || html_to_text(content_html) so the old content is migrated into the plain-text box.

issues: Footnote 'inclui a assinatura da conta predefinida no fim' is shown even when no textual signature is rendered (image-only signature => nothing appended).
React warning: 'Missing Description or aria-describedby for DialogContent' for template-dialog and preview-dialog — add DialogDescription.
Company name is left as 'TEST_Smartize3' from a previous automated run (leftover test data in the seeded environment).

action_items: Templates.jsx openEdit: fall back to a text version of content_html when content_text is empty/shorter, so editing a legacy HTML template does not silently discard its body on save.
Decide on plain-text tracking: either accept 0 opens/clicks for plain-text campaigns and say so in the UI, or rewrite links inside text_body for click tracking.
Add a plain-text signature (or alt-text fallback) for accounts whose signature_html is image-only, otherwise plain-text emails go out unsigned despite the UI footnote.
Add DialogDescription to template-dialog and preview-dialog to clear the Radix a11y warning.
critical_code_review_comments: html_has_visible_content correctly centralises the HTML-vs-text decision and is now used in api.py preview + both worker paths — the iteration-12 gap is fixed (test_iter12_edge.py now passes).
send_email attaches text/html only when html_body is non-empty, so plain-text sends are a genuine single-part text/plain message (verified by MIME unit test).
Templates.jsx is 193 lines, no rich-text code left; content_html is hard-coded to '' in both save() and doPreview() — consistent with the requirement.

Backend still stores/serves content_html for legacy templates and the worker still supports the HTML branch. That is fine for backwards compatibility, but there is no migration: legacy HTML templates cannot be viewed anywhere in the UI anymore.

success_rate.frontend: 95% (all plain-text editor/preview/save/delete flows pass; legacy-template edit loses HTML body)

seed_data_creation: pytest created and deleted TEST_iter13_* templates/groups/contacts/campaigns and qa_iter13_*@example.com contact. UI-created template 'QA Plain iter13' was created and then deleted through the UI (verified gone).
context_for_next_testing_agent: Run pytest with '-n 0' (xdist loadscope in pytest.ini makes older shared-state files flake). App routes are Portuguese: /contactos /grupos /templates /campanhas /negocios /estatisticas /configuracoes. UI inserts {{var}} tokens; backend substitute() accepts both {var} and {{var}}. Templates seeded: 'QA Template 1/2' still hold legacy content_html — useful to retest the openEdit fallback fix. Default SMTP account 'QA SMTP' has an image-only signature_html.
rca_of_the_issue: Legacy-template data loss: Templates.openEdit() builds the form with content_html: '' and content_text: t.content_text only. Templates created before the plain-text simplification keep their body in content_html, so the textarea opens (nearly) empty and save() writes content_html: '' — the original body is unrecoverable. Fix in the frontend openEdit (or a one-off backend migration converting content_html -> content_text).
